description: This file defines the ContentInfoActivity class for an Android TV app, responsible for displaying detailed content information, including background, metadata, action buttons, and handling user interactions such as playback API calls and focus navigation.
external_files: R (resources including strings and drawable icons)

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays detailed content information including metadata, background, and action buttons while handling user navigation and playback API interactions.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate an Intent with extras for launching ContentInfoActivity with specific content metadata.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, populates data, and configures focus and action buttons.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Sets up the system time and date display.

methods.name: populateContentData
methods.description: Populates the activity UI with content data received via intent extras or defaults.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Initializes action buttons, sets icons, labels, focus, and click handlers.

methods.name: animateButtonFocus
methods.description: Animates visual focus state changes for action buttons.

methods.name: handleButtonAction
methods.description: Executes the action associated with a pressed button, including a press animation.

methods.name: handlePlay
methods.description: Performs a GET request to retrieve a media URL and launches the player activity upon success.

methods.name: extractUrlFromResponse
methods.description: Parses server response to extract the media URL, supporting both JSON and plain URL responses.

methods.name: isValidHttpUrl
methods.description: Validates whether a string is a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.
